item.name: Import Form by URL (Typeform / Tally / Google Forms)

request.description: Opens Google consent screen. Follow the redirect in a browser. Requires GOOGLE_FORMS_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_FORMS_CLIENT_SECRET to be configured on the server.
Called by Google after user grants consent. The code param comes from the Google redirect. Store the code in the googleOAuthCode variable.

header.description: Compute HMAC-SHA256 of the body using TYPEFORM_WEBHOOK_SECRET, base64-encode it, prefix sha256=

request.description: Simulates an inbound Typeform webhook. You must compute a valid HMAC-SHA256 signature for the request body and set it in the typeform-signature header.

header.description: Compute base64(HMAC-SHA256(signing secret, raw request body)) using TALLY_WEBHOOK_SECRET

request.description: Simulates an inbound Tally webhook. You must compute a valid base64-encoded HMAC-SHA256 signature over the raw request body and set it in the tally-signature header.
